explication: Open OSCAR Server is a Go instant-messaging server for classic AIM and ICQ clients. Its main workflow accepts client connections through OSCAR-compatible transports, dispatches protocol requests to handlers and domain services, and maintains user, session, buddy-list, and chat state. Separate front ends support TOC, ICQ’s legacy UDP protocol, and AIM’s Web API; an HTTP Management API administers users, sessions, and public chat rooms. The README documents additional messaging, presence, privacy, directory, and file-sharing capabilities. Edges reflect shown calls or README statements; unsampled subsystem links are omitted rather than inferred.
